title: Why Do Hugs Help?
hook: A gentle hug can slow a racing heart.
narration: A gentle hug can slow a racing heart.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Hugs Help.
Warm pressure says you are not alone.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Ask first. Not everyone wants a hug.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
A wave or kind words can be a hug too.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: A gentle hug can slow a racing heart.
The pictures today are a new heart world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do hugs help.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
